messages:
elaine_sales: Quick thread 1: prospect (RegionalBank EU) needs BYO-CMK POC details. Requirements: auto-rotation every 45d, emergency rollback to previous key, 7y audit logs, and a clear perf/price tradeoff note for their security team. Can we draft a single-paragraph explanation + SOW bullets?
omar_solutions: One-paragraph explainer + SOW bullets below. Short version: recommend envelope encryption for production; data keys derived under customer CMK and cached in Redwood runtime. CMK calls limited to key derive/rotation/canary. This gives auditable CMK events while keeping per-request latency minimal. If they require cryptographic proof each request used the CMK, we can do per-request decrypts (higher latency & KMS billing) or hybrid sampling for audit.
eleine_sales: Can you add a short SOW checklist for legal/security?
omar_solutions: SOW bullets:
- Rotation cadence: 45 days (customer-driven)
- Key retention: preserve previous key versions for 90 days post-rotation for emergency decrypts
- Attestations: monthly attestation reports from customer KMS provided to Redwood
- Log retention: 7 years for CMK operation logs and rewrap metadata
- Rollback runbook: staged rewrap canary (5% traffic for 30m), auto-rollback thresholds (error rate >0.5% or latency >+30ms), manual rollback steps and contact list
- Hosted HSM for POC: available as a temporary, paid option with custody-transfer steps defined
- Networking: customer to whitelist Redwood egress IPs to KMS endpoints
vika_security: Add: require cryptographic proof for sampled requests (signed rewrap ids) and require pen-test window before cutover. Also specify who keeps HSM attestations and where theyre stored.
raj_sre: Perf numbers for customer note: naive per-request CMK decrypt = +5-25ms tail depending on KMS region and network; envelope + cached data key = sub-ms overhead. For throughput: envelope approach requires small in-memory data-key cache and batched rewraps during rotation; recommend TTL ~1h and connection pooling to KMS. If they pick per-request CMK flow, plan to increase worker capacity to maintain latency SLOs.
elaine_sales: They also asked: "what does rollback look like in practice?"
omar_solutions: Rollback summary (one-paragraph): "If a rotation causes regressions, Redwood will immediately stop the new rewrap rollout and switch traffic back to the preserved previous key version. The preserved key material remains available for emergency decrypts for 90 days. The SOW includes canary thresholds to trigger automatic rollback and manual runbook steps for cross-team ceremony if a full revert is needed."
eleine_sales: Nice. Last: pricing blurb? They want a simple way to compare costs to pass to procurement.
raj_sre: Pricing blurb: "Expect two cost drivers: (1) KMS provider charges for CMK operations (derive/unwrap/rotate) which scale with the number of CMK calls; (2) Redwood operational surcharge for per-request CMK flows due to added CPU/scale and support. Envelope mode minimizes both: CMK calls limited to rotation/derivation events; per-request CMK adds billable KMS calls and may increase your Redwood service tier costs. Well provide a firm quote if you select an option."
infra-bot: Note created: /presales/2712345680-byo-cmk-rotation-rollback-clarify for follow-up.
eleine_sales: I'll send this to the customer and ask if they want a hosted HSM POC quote. Thanks all :thumbsup:
